Purpose: Resolve customer/business identity for quote ownership
Design Notes: No cross-service database join.

Purpose: Retrieve customer/business profile for risk assessment
Design Notes: Customer & Party remains source of customer profile.

Purpose: Resolve customer identity while creating/handling a claim
Design Notes: Claims stores customerId only.
Do not duplicate the customer master record.

Purpose: Create risk assessment for a quote
Design Notes: Persist returned assessmentId in Quote.

Purpose: Submit risk assessment when quote enters underwriting
Design Notes: Do not mark the underwriting step complete when the call fails.

Purpose: Read risk assessment for policy transaction processing
Design Notes: Use the assessment ID already associated with the quote/policy.
Analytics is advisory; it does not make the final renewal decision.
Workflow owns process state; Quote & Policy owns business state.
Audit is append-only.

Purpose: Validate policy coverage for FNOL and claim assessment
Design Notes: Coverage is read-only; Claims owns claim state.
No second policy master in Claims.
External reference only.
Fallback may retain existing priority; human review remains required.

Purpose: Create recovery case when continuity support is required
Design Notes: claimId is the correlation key.
Claim remains source of claim state.
Never place credentials/JWTs in audit data.

Purpose: Find eligible vendors for recovery support
Design Notes: Vendor service owns vendor eligibility.

Purpose: Create vendor assignment for recovery work
Design Notes: Store assignmentId rather than vendor details.
Recovery owns recovery state.
Notification service owns notification lifecycle.
Append-only audit trail.
No secrets in notification content.
Compliance evidence is referenced by document ID.
Workflow owns task state.
Risk service remains source of risk data.

Purpose: Read policy information for renewal/portfolio analytics
Design Notes: Long-term option: event-fed analytics read model.
Analytics does not modify Claims data.

Purpose: Read risk assessment for analytical scoring
Design Notes: Long-term option: event-fed analytics read model.
